==Walkthrough==
[[File:Cauldron of Thunder location.png|[[Cauldron of Thunder]] location.|thumb]]
{{Checklist|* Talk to [[Kaqemeex]] in the stone circle north of [[Taverley]]. {{Chat option|2I'm in search of a quest.|1Okay, I will try and help.}}
* Talk to [[Sanfew]], who is upstairs in the Herb shop in Taverley. {{Chat option|1I've been sent to help purify the Varrock stone circle.|2Ok, I'll do that then.}}
* Bring the four meats to the [[Cauldron of Thunder|Cauldron]] in [[Taverley Dungeon]], and use them on the Cauldron to enchant them.
* Talk to [[Sanfew]].
* Talk to [[Kaqemeex]].
* '''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
